# Assessment Overview

This directory contains the supplementary assessment documents copied from the generated engine outputs.

- [architecture-diagram.md](architecture-diagram.md) - Architecture diagram and component relationship maps for the servlet application.
- [dependency-map.md](dependency-map.md) - Declared dependency inventory grouped by modernization-relevant category.
- [api-service-contracts.md](api-service-contracts.md) - Endpoint catalog, service communication patterns, and request flow sequence.
- [data-architecture.md](data-architecture.md) - Database configuration, entity model, and persistence boundary summary.
- [configuration-inventory.md](configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, runtime settings, and secrets handling inventory.
- [business-workflows.md](business-workflows.md) - Domain entities, end-to-end workflows, and business decision logic.
